### Hannah Arendt on action

Hannah Arendt (1906–1975) approaches action within political theory. She distinguishes labor, work, and action: action in the public realm discloses agents and founds political freedom. Totalitarianism atomizes society and makes terror a permanent principle, destroying spontaneity. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets action most directly—useful for searches such as “hannah arendt quotes on action.”
